name: OPSD-ES-mp
notes: ENTSO-E ES system load (OPSD time_series 60min, ES_load_actual_entsoe_transparency) + ERA5 weather (Open-Meteo). aux column holds the TSO's own published day-ahead load forecast (ES_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency, coverage 100.0%). exogenous-series rules: (1) a solar/wind series is dropped if its raw data has any single internal gap longer than 720 h (30 d); (2) then dropped if <50% present over the load span (v1). generation columns kept: {'solar': 'ES_solar_generation_actual (max internal gap 6 h)', 'wind': 'ES_wind_onshore_generation_actual (max internal gap 6 h)'}. dropped: [none]. missing cells interpolated: 48 (per channel {'load': 20, 'solar': 14, 'wind': 14}; linear up to 6 h, then ffill/bfill). MULTI-POINT WEATHER VARIANT (revision 2026-10-19): the four weather channels are the population-weighted mean of ERA5 at 6 metropolitan areas (Madrid 6.7M, Barcelona 5.6M, Valencia 1.8M, Sevilla 1.5M, Bilbao 1.0M, Malaga 1.0M); 0 cells interpolated; every other column identical to OPSD-ES.
